_comment: Reviewed local resource checks and operator-only setup hints.
Requests cannot supply commands or arguments. Server-side checks use a fixed command allowlist.
Native configuration references inspect metadata only. Credential file presence does not prove authentication.
Command output is parsed in private and never returned verbatim. Actions are displayed, never executed.

resources.name: Atlassian — Jira + Confluence
resources.summary: Jira is the task system of record; Confluence is the documentation sink. Two paths are both required because MCP cannot be reached from a shell script.

actions.label: Create the REST config
actions.note: Uses getpass: the token is never echoed and never becomes a command argument.

notes: MCP actions use the connected account permissions. Review consequential changes before authorizing them.
Cloud only — no Server/Data Center, no FedRAMP/HIPAA.
Site rate limits: Free 500 calls/hour, Standard and Premium 1000/hour.

resources.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
resources.summary: Native Codex CLI. Authentication and settings remain owned by Codex.

checks.label: logged in
checks.hint: Run codex login in your own terminal if the native client reports that you are signed out.

actions.label: Install or update only if needed (operator action)

notes: CODEX_HOME selects the native configuration directory; its default is ~/.codex. Project and managed settings may also apply.
Codex chooses its own file, keychain or other supported credential store. No credential is copied to Agentmux. A config file is optional and does not prove authentication.
Use the existing client installation and its update channel. A reported version does not qualify the Agentmux integration.

resources.name: xAI Grok Build CLI
resources.summary: Reviewer/analyst agent. Browser or device-code login to the Grok account; XAI_API_KEY is only the non-browser fallback.

checks.label: Native Grok authentication status
checks.hint: Check login in the existing Grok client. Its native non-secret status format requires provider integration qualification; do not infer login from a substring.

checks.label: Legacy Grok credential reference (not login proof)

notes: grok -p BLOCKS ON STDIN. Always redirect from /dev/null when scripting it.
Headless runs need --permission-mode bypassPermissions, or a tool-approval prompt nobody can answer cancels the turn.
Usage is billed per request even with browser login.
Grok is retained as an existing provider resource; its native beta qualification belongs to provider integration work.

resources.name: Claude Code
resources.summary: Native Claude Code. Keep the same client-owned configuration directory and authentication store.

checks.label: Native authentication status
checks.hint: Use claude auth login in your own terminal; keep the same CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.

actions.label: Log in (interactive)
actions.note: Run in your own terminal. Claude Code owns its macOS Keychain or supported fallback store.

notes: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR selects the native settings and credential namespace. Its default is ~/.claude. Do not change it to share or copy a login.
The legacy isolated agent-config reference is retained for compatibility; it is not the native authentication authority.
The CLI auth status lookup is version-dependent. An unsupported command remains unknown, not signed out.

resources.name: agentmux harness
resources.summary: tmux-backed agent orchestration on a dedicated socket.

actions.label: Reinstall the launcher
actions.note: Legacy harness install hint. For the native platform installer, follow docs/PLATFORM_INSTALLATION.md and preserve the enrolled profile.

actions.label: Check Windows state sharing
actions.note: Historical Windows/WSL hint only; not supported by the native macOS ARM64 beta.

notes: The launcher check only observes the stable command reference; it does not establish enrolled runtime readiness.

Run the installed platform doctor for enrollment and broker prerequisites. Use --client claude, --client codex, --client pi or --client claude-desktop for the selected client prerequisites; these do not qualify a complete workflow.

resources.name: Plugins & skills
resources.summary: Client plugin prerequisites and optional plugin listings. Installation and trust remain explicit operator choices.

checks.label: Claude plugins enabled
checks.hint: Enabled state comes from the native JSON listing. Resolve reported load errors in Claude Code; diagnostics never enable or install plugins.

checks.label: grok plugins installed
checks._note: Matches the name@marketplace listing form. A negative lookahead does NOT work here: re.search with re.M finds a match later in the output and reports a false ok.

checks.label: Claude config-directory lookup prerequisite (2.1.268+)
checks.hint: Use the existing Claude Code update channel if this lookup is needed; do not install a second copy.

actions.label: Install a grok plugin (needs --trust)
actions.note: Plugins can run hooks, MCP servers and skills. --trust is an execute-untrusted-code decision.

notes: A plugin listing is a local diagnostic, not permission to install or run a plugin. Missing optional plugins do not remove Resources or setup hints.
The client owns plugin configuration and updates. Check its supported-version requirements before enabling a plugin.
Native client version checks are diagnostic only; installed integration qualification is tracked separately.

resources.name: Pi
resources.summary: Native Pi settings and credentials stay in the client-owned agent directory.

actions.label: Open Pi, then use /login
actions.note: Pi owns provider login. Do not copy auth.json or run credential helper commands from diagnostics.

notes: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR selects the native agent directory; its default is ~/.pi/agent.
A saved credential file does not prove that a provider is usable. Provider environment variables and helpers may also apply; automatic authentication qualification is unknown.
Use /reload after changing supported Pi settings. Use the existing installation and update channel.

resources.name: Claude Desktop
resources.summary: Desktop manages its own sign-in. MCP settings remain in the native application configuration.

checks.label: Desktop sign-in
checks.hint: Check sign-in inside Claude Desktop. No supported non-secret external auth lookup is qualified.

checks.label: Installed application and version
checks.hint: Check Claude Desktop About and its update channel. Bundle presence alone does not qualify the integration.

actions.label: Open native setup
actions.note: Use Settings > Developer > Edit Config. Apply only an Agentmux entry verified against the selected installation and enrollment. Preserve unrelated MCP servers and settings; do not replace the whole file.

notes: Native MCP config: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json.
Restart Desktop to load changed MCP configuration. Keep login in the application; do not inspect or copy its private session storage.
Automatic auth-store inspection and installed-client qualification remain open checks.
